name: Numbers
title: Numbers — Wilderness Formation
tagline: A redeemed people tested, counted, and prepared to enter.
audience: Israel between Sinai and the land.
purpose: Show the cost of unbelief and the faithfulness of God to His promise.
christ: Bronze serpent lifted up (John 3:14–15); star from Jacob (24:17).
spirit: Spirit on the seventy (11); God who leads by cloud.
jesus_in_this_book: Bronze serpent lifted up (John 3:14–15); star from Jacob (24:17).
how_to_read: Note what kills a generation: unbelief, not lack of miracles.
watchman_charge: Finish the march. Do not die in sight of the promise through grumbling.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
